meta.title: In-Platform Stakeholder Collaboration: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Navigate to an in-platform dispute case and use stakeholder collaboration to comment and collaborate
Verify the capability is absent or refused on a tenant below the Growth plan
Repeat the same workflow on a Growth tenant and verify that it works
Compare the same AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor role across lower-plan and Growth tenants
